description: This file declares the RialtoSessionServerStub class, which appears to be a stub implementation for testing or mocking a session server component in the Rialto project. It includes method declarations for starting the stub, retrieving client socket information, sending events, and disconnecting clients. It also defines an enum for stub responses and private members for server and client IPC objects, socket array, and server thread.

classes.name: RialtoSessionServerStub
classes.description: A stub class for simulating a session server in tests, providing methods to start, communicate, and disconnect.

methods.description: Starts the stub with a specified response type.
